good_ice: Dad said 'that'll do'. From him, that's a parade.
bad_ice: Not putting sixty-year-olds on that. Not my dad.
goal: Was that Dad? Was it a pass? It was a pass.
leaving_happy: Great night. Invoice to follow. Kidding. Mostly.
leaving_angry: I'll be calling Priya. Nicely. Firmly.

broomball: My one night of sitting still. Don't make me stand up.
special: Clipboard and backup clipboard. Let's go.

first.say: Tracy Haverstock. Ronnie's daughter, yes, but I also have a name and a spreadsheet. Dad says hi. He didn't, but he would.

options.text: Could your dad sign something for me?

first_nice.say: See, that's how you do it. Most people say 'Ronnie's daughter' and then wait.

first_sign.say: He'll say yes. He always says yes. That's why I say no for him. Sorry. Not sorry.

say: The Invitational's two weeks out and the beer garden licence is a rumour. I don't do rumours.

broom.say: Wednesday. My partner plays. It's the only night I sit still. Don't make me stand up.

special.say: Big night. I've got a clipboard and a backup clipboard. Dad's hiding in the canteen.

say: Hey. Dad says you're good people. He said 'fine people'. Same thing.
Hi! I've got a list. Want to be on it?
What do you need? I've probably already booked it.

options.text: Tell me about the Old-timers' Invitational.
What do you like coming to?
How's working with Dale and Priya?
Is the rink ready for the Invitational?

oldtimers.say: Dad's name, Dad's friends, a beer garden and a concessions split I will argue to the cent. Dad thinks it's too much fuss. It's exactly enough fuss.

options.text: I'll sort the beer garden licence.

do.note: You promised Tracy Haverstock the beer garden licence for the Old-timers' Invitational.

events.say: The specials. The Invitational, the Carnival, the Christmas skate. And broomball on Wednesdays, because I love someone who plays it.

dad.say: He won't ask for anything, ever. So I ask for him. Then I apologise to him for asking. It's a system.

dale.say: Dale has a bylaw for beer gardens. Priya has a time slot for Dale. I have them both on speed dial.

rink_good.say: The ice? Dad said 'that'll do'. From him, that's a parade.

rink_rooms.say: Dressing rooms that don't smell like 1994. The Cup sat on my shop counter that year and it smelled better.
